newsitem.title: INDIA: India shares jump in kerb deals on TMC news.
newsitem.headline: India shares jump in kerb deals on TMC news.

text.p: Indian stocks surged in kerb trading on Tuesday after the regional Tamil Maanila Congress (TMC) party decided to rejoin the government, traders said.

Among blue chips stocks, Reliance Industries was quoted at 309.50/310 rupees, up 4.75/5.25 compared to its official close of 304.75. SBI rose 8.0 rupees to 321 rupees, ITC 5.25 to 415 rupees and TISCO 3.0 to 184.0.

G.K. Moopanar the leader, of former finance minister P. Chidambaram's TMC, said late on Tuesday that the party had decided to join Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's one week-old government, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
